<observations>
Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User stated kitchen remodel budget is $28,500.
* 🟡 (09:00) User initially picked Fog Gray backsplash (later changed to Sea Glass/MarbleMist).
* ✅ (13:30) Agent compiled countertop quotes and sent revised quote package to user (19:35).

Date: May 16, 2026
* 🔴 (10:15) User upgraded range hood to 900 CFM model; received $2,750 quote from VentMaster Inc.
* 🔴 (16:00) User changed backsplash tile to Sea Glass.
* ✅ (16:15) Agent sent visual mock‑up PDF for quartz windowsill option.

Date: May 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User selected matte black AquaFlow faucet; postponed demolition until new flooring arrives.
* ✅ (11:15) Received quartz slabs shipping confirmation from StoneEdge Fabricators (ETA June 5).
* ✅ (13:20) Uploaded updated permit checklist to shared folder.

Date: May 22, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) Backsplash area measured at 12.5 sq ft (MarbleMist tile samples requested from TileMosaic Co.).
* 🔴 (08:35) User selected "Honey Oak Classic" engineered oak flooring from FloorCraft (delivery expected June 12).
* 🔴 (10:40) User selected "Soft Sand" paint (Pantone 13-0915) for upper cabinets.
* ✅ (12:20) HOA approved the remodel permit.

Date: May 26, 2026
* 🔴 (09:05) User selected "Cascade Ridge" waterfall edge for quartzite island countertop (TopStone/EdgeCraft, delivery July 15).
* 🔴 (10:15) Cabinet demolition rescheduled for June 20 with foreman Luis Ortega.
* 🔴 (18:45) User confirmed "AquaPure 24" sink replacement.
* ✅ (13:15) Electrical permit amendment for additional outlets approved.

Date: May 30, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) Island countertop length confirmed at 9 ft 4 in.
* 🔴 (17:30) Cabinet delivery scheduled for July 2, 2026.
* 🔴 (18:20) User added built‑in "Vintner 24" wine cooler to be installed beside the refrigerator.
* 🟡 (10:30) Ordered 12 sq m of "Midnight Slate" quartzite (delivery August 5) and scheduled EcoFlow Plumbing for July 18.
* 🟡 (12:50) Ordered 4 ft × 6 ft frosted glass pantry panel from ClearView Glassworks (ETA July 12).
* ✅ (13:30) Received revised electrical layout from Miller & Co. showing two additional GFCI outlets.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Coordinate kitchen remodel schedules, including the July 2 cabinet delivery, July 12 pantry panel, July 15 quartzite delivery, and July 18 plumbing installation.
- Secondary: Review final appliance and fixture placements (including the newly added Vintner 24 wine cooler).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've updated the project details to include the Vintner 24 wine cooler and confirmed the July 2 cabinet delivery. Would you like to review the complete timeline leading up to demolition and installation?"
</suggested-response>
